chemprop2019.citation: Yang et al., J. Chem. Inf. Model. 59, 3370-3389 (2019) - D-MPNN / chemprop, arXiv:1904.01561v5
chemprop2019.note: Table 4 attests the dataset sizes (ESOL 1128, FreeSolv 642, Lipophilicity 4200, BACE 1513) used by this round. The per-dataset result panels are figures, not numeric tables, so no D-MPNN scalar is transcribed from this source.

grover2020.citation: Rong et al., NeurIPS 33 (2020) - GROVER, arXiv:2007.02835v2
grover2020.note: Table 1 (p. 7): classification ROC-AUC and regression RMSE, mean(std) over 3 runs. Sec. 4.2: 'we apply the scaffold splitting for all tasks on all datasets', so these measure a harder regime than the random-split rows of this round.

molnet2018.citation: Wu et al., Chem. Sci. 9, 513-530 (2018) - MoleculeNet
molnet2018.note: Table 1 (dataset table: per-dataset molecule count and split method) and Table 3 (test-subset best conventional vs best graph-based number). One number per model, no multi-seed statistics, no per-example split indices. The PMC HTML carries a per-request nonce, so the sha256 changes on re-fetch even when the bytes are the same length (242320 B); the earlier Sprint-01 fetch had sha256 f5ba3f55... and the two transcripts were compared row by row.
